Name: Planet Crashmania 9,000,000
Overview: Your planet's orbit is decaying and it's about to meet its demise! Build rockets to pilot your people to the safety of nearby planets. Beware of asteroids and alien invaders who want to destroy your planet! Build nukes to eliminate the aliens and clear asteroids from your path. But be careful not to nuke the planets! Watch for power-ups and use nukes to shoot them down and reap the benefits!
